asdfghjkl.definition:
1) An expression of frustration for IM; Used in desperation when no other words will do.\r
\r
2) A conversation filler, also in IMing, when no one has said anything in a while.\r
\r
*with any of these there can be added letters as well as semi colons. It is usually a personal preference. 
> 1) Person 1: asdfghjkl
> Person 2: whats wrong?
> Person 1: i have so much homework and my mom is bugging me about my grades.
> 2) *After 10 minutes*
> Person 1: asdfghjkl
> Person 1: so whats up?
> Person 2: nm u?
> etc.
